definitions.short: properly, separation ; by implication, a part of the body, branch of a tree, bar for carrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart , only , besides
definitions.usage: alone, apart, bar, besides, branch, by self, of each alike, except, only, part, staff, strength.
